notes.title: A new game announced! Ale Abbey, a monastery brewery tycoon!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789460/Ale_Abbey/

Ale Abbey is a monastery brewery tycoon set in the late Middle Ages. Assign your carefully selected crew of brewers to research new styles and better practices, craft recipes, and brew beer using real-life tools and methods. 

But that's not the end of it! Trade your beer in the surrounding villages and towns, store your beer for your own little brewers or use it to sway Lords and Bandits alike to win their favor.

Made by a team that appreciates beer and respects the art of crafting it, Ale Abbey is a pixelated wink to the ones that not only kept the craft alive but also perfected it through harder and darker times. Accurate
ingredients, realistic practices, demanding audiences (!), and a handful of trusty monks and nuns ready to
brew. Although realistic, Ale Abbey has been developed under the premise of being zen and stress-free, so it introduces almost no punishing gameplay mechanics.

As traditional with us, we have a huge focus on music too. Did you know that [b]Clint Bajakian[/b] ([i]Monkey Island games, Uncharted, God of War, etc[/i]) is in charge of the soundtrack and the sound design?  

I hope you guys will wishlist it, and gives us your trust to prove you what we can deliver! (this time the team is almost twice the size of the previous works too!)

Cheers,
Dr.H
* If you hit Spacebar in the Settings menu, it will deactivate the strobo and glitch effects when the Pod is damaged or scrambled

notes.title: Our game, Empires in Ruins, leaves early access with a 20% discount.
notes.notes:
Even though I released [b]Razerwire:Nanowars[/b] in 2018, and we produced [b]Headbängers in Holiday Hell[/b] in December 2020, I have been working on Empires in Ruins, with ups and downs due to freelancing, since 2015. In february 2018 we released it in Early Access, and now, after 13 months, we are finally ready for the big release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/604510/Empires_in_Ruins/

Even though fully different in visuals and style from our already released games, we did craft Empires in Ruins with the same intent and passion. To create something unique, with character and personality. Even though it might not be your cup of tea, it would be awesome if you could give it a wishlist if just to help us gaining a bit more of visibility!

If you like it instead, well, that's even better and you are welcome to buy it, play it, enjoy it and review it!

See you soon,
Cheers,
Dr.H

notes.title: Razerwire is back!
notes.notes:
I did let Razerwire rest for quite a while, didn't we? You guys liked it and played it for now almost three years (HOLY CRAP!), and it's quite some times that we play with the idea that Razerwire needs some more love.
And this is the first step! First of all, I now updated the game to the latest unity build, making sure that it's using the most recent drivers and technology.
Then I fixed some usability issues with the menus, mouse cursor and saves. And now...well, what comes next I can't spoil yet, but I am fairly sure that you will appreciate it!
Until then, if any problem, please don't hesitate to write in the forum, the Wire is back!

[b]v1.2.0[/b]
[list]
[*] Ported the game to the latest unity build and fixed related issues
[*] Locked cursor on screen for multidisplay setups
[*] Improved navigation of the upgrades menu for mouse and pad
[*] Stabilized usage of settings menu (for both pad and mouse)
[*] Fixed a minor bug that restored a deleted saved if not overwritten right away
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 1.07 - Full controller support
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31950538/b8c43eff184b91de723d2005800c18b304a4d141.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31950538/bcc505ac3aff6400ca74a35b452e73f7a5dcf277.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added [b]Full controller support[/b], Game and Menu
[*] Changed the naming system for new profiles to allow use in [b]Big Picture[/b]
[*] Shortened the duration of the Nanoblade (tiers 2 and 3)
[/list]


Dear Razewires, the time has come for a big update.

Lots of you asked for a fully supported game controller build of RWNW, and here we are! 

Personally I think think that having been born with mouse in mind as a controller, the game is quite harder with controller, even though after a while that I was playing with it I started loving it. But on the other hand, I am SO BAD with the controller, that I hardly represent a standard user :D

But that said, now it's in, you can choose to use it or not, your pick (Just go to the settings menu and select the controller type). The big cool thing is that you can now play from your sofa :P

The naming of a new profile has now been automated, so that you can use the game from Big Picture without having to use the keyboard at all.
As part of the balancing, the nanoblade has been slightly underpowered by reducing its duration according to some of the latest user feedback.

I am gonna be away for one week guys, I am back on the 18th. If any problem, write me, post, etc, but I don't know if I will be able to answer until that day! Have a blast!

Cheers,
Hogan, @DokHgn

notes.title: Post MayThe4th-ic Chill
notes.notes:
Hello dear players of RWNW!!

Sales are over, and with it the MayThe4th Edition too. The traditional Generators are back in place, only the beam remained by mistake the MayThe4th Edition color for now ;)

Anyway, there will be [b]a new Special Edition next month[/b], with a couple of additional tiny fixes and [b]possibly a new powerup[/b] too, so stay tuned if you wanna try them in action! I am also still experimenting with the Controller integration, but up until now I didn't find any comfortable integration with the game gameplay. RWNW is really mouse bound, so it's hard to break that bond somehow!

As a last thing, [b]a big big thanks to everybody that left a review[/b]. Reviews are what keeps a game afloat or sinks it on Steam nowadays, and while RWNW might not be a top seller, I am extremely proud of how it's doing and of the 100% current positive reviews ratio. 

Cheers,
Emiliano, @DokHgn

notes.title: Major update 1.03!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31950538/b8c43eff184b91de723d2005800c18b304a4d141.png[/img]

Update 1.03
[list]
[*][b]Leaderboards visible in game from the Main Menu! [/b]
[*]Increased the power of Tiers 1,2 and 3 of the Antimatter powerup (Now 4,8 and 16 shots while before it was 2,4 and 8 shots)
[*]Increased the power of Tiers 1,2 and 3 of the Nanomissiles powerup (Now 2,3 and 7 missiles while before it was 1,2 and 3 missiles)
[*]Anabolishields provides immunity to Mines explosion
[*]Increased the loading time for Tiers 1,2 and 3 of the Powerwave (Now 6/5/4 seconds)
[/list]

Barely 2 weeks from release, already 3rd update and a major one at that? Well yes! Why? 
Because release gave me access to a wider and more varied set of players, and therefore I could gather more feedback and get better ideas for the game.

The "in-game" part of the update aimed at balancing out some powerups, decreasing a bit the power of the Powerwave and making the other powerups sexier and stronger also at their base tiers. 

The second side of the update is on UIs and usability. I did add a very short explaination panel on the first match for a profile, in order to show the very basics of gameplay, and above all, I finally got the leaderboards in game. 
Now you can keep a constant eye on the competition without leaving the game. As a last thingy, if you enjoy the game, please leave a review, they're vital for RWNW to get some visibility on Steam!

Cheers and thanks guys!
Emiliano, @DokHgn

notes.title: Mac Os X version available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31950538/b8c43eff184b91de723d2005800c18b304a4d141.png[/img]

It's here! After a couple of days of struggle, Razerwire is now also available for [b]Mac Os X[/b]. 

The only limitation is that even though performance-wise it would have no issues in running on much older machines, it requires the operative system to be at least 10.9 or newer. Blame it on the engine, unfortunately there is nothing I can do about that.

But tech surveys seem to show that 98% of the active steam mac users have newer OS, so I hope it won't be a problem.


Enjoy!
Emiliano, @DokHgn

notes.title: First Update already!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31950538/b8c43eff184b91de723d2005800c18b304a4d141.png[/img]

Updates 1.01+1.02
[list]
[*]Decreased by 1 second the jammed Wiredrive duration.
[*]Increased the score value of low tier enemies.	
[*]Increased by 2 the number of base enemies per wave.
[*]Shortened the progress of appearance of stronger enemies.
[*]Slightly reduced maximum waiting time for powerups.
[*]Anabolishield now provides immunity from scrambling bullets and has slightly increased duration.
[/list]

[b]Hello Razerwireres![/b]

It should not come as a surprise that less than 48 hours after the steam release I am already pushing the first update. 

RWNW™ went through quite a lot of beta testing for such a small game, but I was sure that more and new feedback would have popped up upon release. Wider community, new gamers, new ideas and new opinions.

What I basically did here up until now, listening to the new community on Steam, is to shorten up the first phase of the game. Several players deemed the first 4-5 minutes of the game to be a bit too slow and too punitive (specially in the duration of the jammed WireDrive).

One additional small fix has been the adding of a feature to the anabolishield powerup, otherwise considered to be the weakest one. The pimped up shield now also makes the WireDrive immune from scrambling when active and lasts longer.

Enjoy and see you soon on the leaderboards!
Cheers,
Emiliano, @DokHgn
